summary: Fix Grok Build post-activation surfacing for plate-core MCP and bundled skills by adopting the mcpServers wrapper in .mcp.json.
migration_impact: Grok users must reinstall or update plate-core after this ships (`grok plugin install plate-core@plate-marketplace --trust` or `grok plugin update`) and reload the TUI. Bundled skills require the #577 payload (skills/ + SKILLS.md) in the installed copy.
agent_notes: Grok runtime ignores flat .mcp.json server maps even though grok plugin validate passes. Official marketplace plugins (vercel, neon, mongodb) all wrap servers under mcpServers. Pair with --trust at install for stdio MCP execution.
migration_guidance: 1. Ensure pip install plate-core so plate-mcp is on PATH.
2. grok plugin install plate-core@plate-marketplace --trust (or reinstall from .plugin).
3. Enable plugin + reload TUI; run grok inspect and confirm plate-core (stdio) MCP and plugin: plate-core skills.
4. If an older marketplace install remains, uninstall duplicates and reinstall once.
